entries.12648cbac9196823: This is a hotel operation service that enhances the value of stays by creating spatial value that incorporates regional character and elements such as culture and art. It is mainly carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Columbia Hotel & Resorts Co., Ltd., which launched the new hotel brand “NOCTIS.” Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥300 million.
entries.15165a45f202f0ca: Affluent individuals and their asset management companies
entries.52a845628c6ace22: A real estate development company that develops rental apartments, offices and hotels in major metropolitan areas, and also handles rental management and hotel operation.
entries.6b3aa34128cade1f: Users of group travel and long-term stays
entries.75465c24d4a92e3a: This service continues after developed properties are sold, providing leasing support for commercial facilities and other properties, offices and residences, arranging cleaning and equipment maintenance and inspection, managing daily schedules, and handling administrative reporting on behalf of clients, among other tasks. It is provided by the consolidated subsidiary Columbia Community Co., Ltd., covering one metropolis and three prefectures (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama and Chiba). Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥443 million.
entries.87d7734d4d08f330: Investors and owners who purchased developed properties
entries.a86cb6ff7105a910: These services cover everything from land acquisition to development and sales of residences (rental condominiums), offices, hotels and other properties. Residences are developed under the brands “Blancé” and “LUMIEC,” value-up type projects under “LUMIEC un,” and offices under “BIASTA.” It uses three schemes (self-developed, fund-based and value-up) selectively and targets major metropolitan areas. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥35,942 million.
entries.e4beb698570d3347: This is the business of the group consisting of Columbia Works Inc., headquartered in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, and six consolidated subsidiaries. The business is a single segment of real estate development, and the consolidated number of employees for the fiscal year ended December 2025 is 84. It mainly provides real estate development services, and also provides real estate leasing management services, hotel operation services and asset management services.
entries.ecc7e161a126b3f4: Entrusted by investors, this service handles asset building, asset management and asset preservation. It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Columbia Asset Management Co., Ltd., which completed in 2025 the change of registration for its investment management business (real estate-related specified investment management business) and its Type II Financial Instruments Business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥398 million.
